defects.description: Jump virtual button (canvas hotspot hs-jump; the most frequent, time-critical input of the runner) sits in the top-right corner in 780x360 landscape: box {x:708,y:12,w:60,h:60}, centre (738,42) = 318 CSS px (~58 mm on Galaxy S24, ~0.183 mm/CSS px) above the bottom edge and 42 px from the right edge. In a two-thumb landscape grip the right thumb rests near the lower-right; every jump needs a long upward thumb extension/regrip out of the comfortable zone, then a return. Clean variant: jump at {x:560,y:184,w:72,h:72} inside the lower-right thumb arc.
defects.human_factors_basis: Functional thumb area on touchscreens (Bergstrom-Lehtovirta & Oulasvirta, CHI 2014) and landscape two-handed touch-zone guidance (Hoober 2013; Clark, Designing for Touch 2015): primary/frequent game actions belong in the lower corners where thumbs rest; top corners require extension and grip shifts, increasing movement time (Fitts' law) and grip instability.

defects.description: Attack virtual button (hs-attack, declared primary) is in the top-left corner {x:12,y:12,w:60,h:60} while the movement stick is at the bottom-left {x:4,y:300,w:56,h:56}. In landscape two-thumb grip the LEFT thumb must leave the stick and travel ~286 CSS px (~52 mm) upward to attack, so moving and attacking cannot be done together and each attack is a stretch out of the thumb's comfortable zone. Clean variant: attack at bottom-right {x:648,y:228,w:92,h:92} under the right thumb.
defects.human_factors_basis: Thumb functional area / reach models (Bergstrom-Lehtovirta & Oulasvirta 2014; Hoober 2013 landscape zones); mobile game control-layout guidance (Game Accessibility Guidelines: place controls for comfortable reach, avoid simultaneous inputs on the same digit) and Fitts' law movement time for long thumb excursions.

defects.description: Virtual joystick (hs-stick) is tiny and flush to the screen corner: base 56x56 CSS px (~10 mm diameter, i.e. about one thumb-pad contact width, knob excursion only ~+/-28 px = +/-5 mm) at {x:4,y:300}, only 4 px (~0.7 mm) from both the left and bottom edges. The thumb occludes the whole control, direction resolution is poor, and the control lies inside the Android gesture-navigation system-gesture insets (edge back-swipe / bottom home zone), so drags from the edge can trigger system gestures. Clean variant: 132x132 base with 40 px margins from both edges.
defects.human_factors_basis: Thumb contact size and touch-target research (Parhi, Karlson & Bederson 2006: >=9.6 mm for single taps, larger for continuous thumb control); Android developer guidance on gesture navigation (keep interactive controls out of system-gesture insets) and Apple HIG (avoid controls near screen edges/Home indicator); Game Accessibility Guidelines: make virtual controls large and well spaced.

defects.description: HUD score/HP text (#hud-stats, '점수 … · HP …/100') is rendered at font-size 10px (box 122x20 at x=106,y=22). On Galaxy S24 (~0.183 mm/CSS px) digits are ~1.3 mm tall, ~13-15 arcmin at a 300-350 mm handheld viewing distance, below the ISO 9241-303 minimum character height of 16 arcmin and below platform minimum text sizes (Apple HIG 11 pt, Material 12 sp). Contrast is fine (14.4:1) - this is a size defect. Clean variant: 15px.
defects.human_factors_basis: ISO 9241-303:2011 / ANSI-HFES 100-2007 minimum character height 16 arcmin (preferred 20-22); Apple HIG minimum 11 pt, Material Design minimum 12 sp; Game Accessibility Guidelines / Xbox Accessibility Guideline 101 (text legibility, adequate default text size); worse for presbyopic and low-acuity players.

defects.description: Dialogue subtitle (#subtitle) is white #ffffff text with no backing plate directly over the bright sky game art (#stage background #8fd3ff; clouds pass behind it): contrast 1.62:1, far below 4.5:1 for 15px text. The subtitle carries the instructions needed to play each stage. Clean variant: opaque #15191e plate, 16px, 17.7:1.
defects.human_factors_basis: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum) 4.5:1; Game Accessibility Guidelines / Xbox Accessibility Guideline 104 (subtitles and captions: use a background or letterbox so text is readable over any game art); worse in bright sunlight glare.

defects.description: Quick-time prompt (#qte, declared timed; timing window qte-1) is visible for only 300 ms (measured 300 ms in Playwright; the prompt stays up for its whole window even when hit, so visible_duration equals the response window). A human must detect the prompt, decide, move the thumb ~100+ px to it and touch within 300 ms, which is shorter than typical visual choice reaction time (~350-500 ms) plus movement time and touch/display latency (~50-100 ms). A miss costs HP and repeats. Clean variant: 2500 ms window.
defects.human_factors_basis: Human reaction-time literature (simple visual RT ~200-250 ms, choice RT ~350-500 ms, Hick-Hyman law; slower with age) plus Fitts movement time and end-to-end touch latency; Game Accessibility Guidelines (avoid/allow adjustment of QTEs and timing), Xbox Accessibility Guideline 107 (input timing adjustable); analogous to WCAG 2.2.1 Timing Adjustable.

defects.description: Hit effect (#flash, timing window hit-fx) is a full-viewport (780x360, 100% of the screen) saturated red #ff1a1a overlay at 0.85 opacity toggled every 60 ms for ~2 s after the player is hit: measured 17 on-phases in 2.04 s, max 9 flashes within any 1-second window. Exceeds the 3-flashes-per-second limit with a large area and a saturated-red transition (photosensitive seizure risk). Clean variant: one single 1.5 s appearance of a small 111x24 px '피격! HP -20' chip (under 1% of the screen).
defects.human_factors_basis: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.3.1 Three Flashes or Below Threshold (general and red flash thresholds); ITU-R BT.1702 / Ofcom photosensitive epilepsy guidance (no more than 3 flashes per second, saturated red transitions); Harding test criteria.

defects.description: Grab escape (#mash, '연타해서 탈출! n/15') requires 15 separate rapid taps and offers no hold, toggle or assist alternative (a 1.5 s press-and-hold was verified not to escape). Repeated rapid input is fatiguing and impossible for players with tremor, RSI or limited dexterity, and hard in a two-thumb grip. Clean variant: hold >= 600 ms or 3 taps.
defects.human_factors_basis: Game Accessibility Guidelines (basic): avoid repeated inputs / button mashing, provide alternatives; Xbox Accessibility Guideline 107 (input: provide hold/toggle alternatives to rapid repeated presses); AbleGamers Includification; WCAG 2.1.1/2.5.1 spirit (operable without demanding repeated/complex gestures).

defects.description: Supply-target picker (#radar with markers #radar-1 and #radar-2, both identical 56 px circles without text or shape difference) distinguishes enemy vs ally only by colour: red #ec3c32 vs green #34a614 (legend is also colour dots only). Under Machado-2009 deuteranopia simulation the two markers differ by only dE76 ~0.1 (normal vision dE76 ~122), so a deutan player cannot tell which marker is the ally and the task step (tap the ally) becomes a guess; the wrong pick costs HP. (Protan simulation still leaves dE76 ~38, so this is deutan-specific.) Findings on #radar-1/#radar-2 count. Clean variant: orange square labelled '적' vs blue circle labelled '아군'.
defects.human_factors_basis: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1 Use of Color; red-green (deutan) colour-vision deficiency affects roughly 5-6% of males; CVD simulation per Machado, Oliveira & Fernandes (2009); Game Accessibility Guidelines: do not convey information by colour alone.

defects.description: List toolbar icon buttons (#tools-add, #tools-copy, #tools-move, #tools-filter, #tools-refresh inside #tools) are 14x14 CSS px with 2 px gaps (16 px pitch, x 1396-1474, y 162). They are below the 24x24 minimum and fail the spacing exception (24 px circles centred on adjacent targets overlap). #tools-add is used in the task flow. Clean variant: 32x32 buttons with 8 px gaps.
defects.human_factors_basis: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.5.8 Target Size (Minimum) 24x24 CSS px with spacing exception; Fitts' law (small width -> longer movement time, higher error rate); pointing error rises further with tremor or ageing (Wobbrock et al. 2008 error model).

defects.description: Destructive '전체 삭제' (#delete-all, red, box x 1510-1611, y 720-760) is fused to the primary '저장' button (#save, x 1426-1510) as a split-button pair with 0 px gap and equal size; clicking it wipes the member list immediately with no confirmation or undo. A small overshoot/slip from Save lands on Delete all. Clean variant: delete-all moved to the opposite end of the action row (>1100 px from Save), outline style, with a confirmation dialog.
defects.human_factors_basis: Nielsen heuristic #5 error prevention; Apple HIG / Material Design guidance to visually and spatially separate destructive actions from primary actions and confirm irreversible ones; Fitts/endpoint-distribution models of pointing error (adjacent targets without a gap turn overshoot into activation of the neighbour).

defects.description: Critical system status (#notice, declared critical_message: '결제 모듈 동기화 실패 - 새 멤버 권한이 반영되지 않을 수 있음') is rendered as a gradient promo card with a sticker badge, decorative art and pill CTA in the far-right rail (x 1664-1904, y 88-347), directly above a real ad (#promo) with the identical card template. Users performing the form task in the main column are unlikely to look at or read it (banner blindness, peripheral/right-rail position). Clean variant: plain amber inline alert (role=alert) at the top of the main content column.
defects.human_factors_basis: Banner blindness (Benway & Lane 1998; Pagendarm & Schaumburg 2001; Nielsen Norman Group eyetracking 2007/2018: users ignore ad-like styling and right-rail content); visual attention concentrates on the task area (F-pattern / useful field of view).

defects.description: New-member form inputs (#member-name, #member-email, #member-role inside fieldset #member) are identified only by a 1px #e0e0e0 border on a white card: non-text contrast 1.32:1 < 3:1, so the field boundaries are hard to perceive (low vision, glare, low-quality monitors). Clean variant: #6b7280 border, 4.83:1.
defects.human_factors_basis: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.11 Non-text Contrast (3:1 for visual information required to identify UI components and their boundaries).

defects.description: After clicking Save with the email empty, the only error feedback is a small summary #form-errors that appears in the page title row (box x 576-896, y 90-123, 14px); the user's pointer/gaze is on #save (x 1426-1510, y 720-760). Nearest-edge distance ~798 px (~20 deg of visual angle on a 24-inch 1080p monitor at 600 mm), centre distance ~968 px (~24 deg). There is no inline message at the field, no focus move, no scroll and nothing changes near the button, so the failed save is likely missed. Clean variant: summary directly beside Save (12 px gap), inline error under the email field, focus moved to the field.
defects.human_factors_basis: Feedback should appear at the locus of attention: useful field of view / inattentional & change blindness (Ball et al. UFOV; Simons & Levin 1997); NN/g error-message guidelines (place errors next to the source field); GOV.UK error-summary pattern requires moving focus to the summary plus inline errors; WCAG 3.3.1 / 3.3.3.

defects.description: Important consequence text (#apply-note: permission changes take up to 24 h to apply) is 12px #5f6368 (contrast 6.05:1 passes). On a 24-inch 1080p monitor (~0.277 mm/px) Hangul glyphs are ~2.9 mm, ~16-17 arcmin at 600 mm - at the ISO minimum and below the preferred 20-22 arcmin; presbyopic / 60s+ users at intermediate distance will struggle. Subtle, profile-specific. Clean variant: 15px.
defects.human_factors_basis: ISO 9241-303 character height (min 16', preferred 20-22'); presbyopia and age-related acuity loss at intermediate viewing distances; age-inclusive guidelines (W3C WAI older users; NN/g senior usability) recommend >=16px body text.

defects.description: Save confirmation toast (#toast, declared status/timed; timing window save-toast) carries a 14-word / ~45-syllable message with an important caveat (approval required, up to 24 h delay, old permissions stay) but auto-dismisses after 1500 ms (measured 1500-1501 ms), with no way to extend or reopen it. Reading it takes roughly 3.5-4.5 s at average adult silent-reading speed (~200-240 wpm) plus time to notice it and move the eyes there - longer for older, low-vision or distracted users - so 1.5 s allows reading only about a third. Clean variant: toast persists until the user closes it (닫기).
defects.human_factors_basis: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.2.1 Timing Adjustable (auto-dismissing content must be adjustable/extendable) and 4.1.3 Status Messages; Material Design snackbar guidance (4-10 s, longer text needs longer or persistent display); reading-rate data (Brysbaert 2019 meta-analysis: ~238 wpm silent reading for adults), slower for older/low-vision readers.

decoys.description: Pause hotspot at top-centre {x:368,y:8,w:44,h:44} is outside the two-thumb comfort zone, but it is an infrequent, non-time-critical control; placing it away from the resting thumbs deliberately prevents accidental pauses (Hoober: put infrequent/disruptive actions outside the natural thumb zone). Size meets 44 pt.

Game title wordmark '별빛 러너' on the start screen is #2f3b4c on #0d1117 (1.67:1), but it is a logotype - WCAG 1.4.3 exempts text that is part of a logo or brand name; the actionable text '화면을 탭해서 시작' is high-contrast.

Score pop-up '+100' (#pop, declared timed) shows for only 600 ms, but it is short, non-essential, redundant feedback (the score is persistently shown in the HUD) and requires no action - not a timing barrier.
HUD coin icon (#coin, 16x16 px, ~0.09% of the screen) pulses opacity 1.0->0.6 at 1 Hz continuously: fewer than 3 flashes per second and far below the area threshold, so it passes WCAG 2.3.1.
Help icon button is 20x20 px (< 24) but its nearest neighbouring target (#avatar) is 40 px away, so a 24 px circle centred on it intersects nothing: passes WCAG 2.5.8 via the spacing exception.
Disabled 'CSV 내보내기' button has low text contrast (#a3a9b3 on #f3f4f6, 2.15:1) but is disabled; inactive user-interface components are exempt from WCAG 1.4.3 and 1.4.11.
Header wordmark 'ORBIT Console' has a light 'Console' part (#c9ced6 on white, 1.58:1); it is part of the logotype, which WCAG 1.4.3 exempts.

Row delete icon is destructive but 32x32 px, separated by 24 px from the neighbouring edit icon, not adjacent to the primary action, and asks for confirmation in a dialog before deleting - acceptable.

Promotional card in the right rail (declared ad_like, labelled '광고') is likely ignored (banner blindness), which is harmless: it is not critical to the task. Only the critical status styled like it is a problem.

clean_controls.notes: game-clean.html: same flow with defects fixed - jump/attack in the lower-right thumb arc, 132 px stick with 40 px edge margins, 15px HUD text, subtitles on an opaque plate (17.7:1), 2500 ms QTE window, a single small hit chip instead of strobing, hold-or-3-taps escape, shape+text ally/enemy markers (orange square '적' / blue circle '아군'). Decoys (hs-pause, #logo, #pop, #coin) are unchanged.

admin-clean.html: same flow with defects fixed - 32x32 toolbar buttons with 8 px gaps, delete-all at the far end of the action row with outline style and a confirmation dialog, sync failure shown as an inline alert at the top of the main column, #6b7280 input borders (4.83:1), error summary directly beside Save plus inline field error and focus move (no layout shift), 15px apply note, persistent toast with a close button. Decoys (#nav-help, #export, #brand, #row-remove, #promo) are unchanged.
